pages.text: $(bold)Fishing Handbook$()$(br)A codex of everything the Nanshan rod can catch, recording each fish habitat, diet, active hours and catch status.
$(bold)The New Angling System$()$(br)Cast the hook and wait for the float to stir; once a fish bites you enter the fighting stage, holding your gaze steady on the float to reel it in.
$(bold)Casting & Fighting$()$(br)Reeling, giving line, locking your gaze - it plays out much like a real tug-of-war.
